whySystem.intro: In a factory, HR runs on a tight operational tempo. Shift rosters must be published quickly, wages calculated for the next bank cycle, and an auditor may arrive at any point and ask to see a signed register. The system is built for that pace.
problems: Attendance sits in one tool, payroll in another, compliance in Excel — the same data keyed again and again.
Numbers on one report do not agree with numbers on another.
Corrections happen constantly, but no one can prove who did what or why.
Statutory filings are assembled by hand.
No one knows current headcount versus budget until close-of-cycle.
Shift and rest-day rules live in a supervisor's head, not in the system.
wins: One employee record used by every form.
Attendance flows from the biometric to payroll without anyone re-typing it.
Every approval is logged with the user and a note.
EOBI, Social Security and Provident Fund packs ready in one click.
A dashboard that shows current strength before your first meeting.
No department can quietly go over its overtime or salary budget.

deployment.name: Server
deployment.detail: Windows Server 2016+; SQL Server 2016+ (Standard or Enterprise). Two catalogues — Live and Test — identical schema. File share for auto-update and payslip archive. Full backup + log backup rotation with off-site copy.

deployment.name: Client
deployment.detail: Windows 10 / 11; .NET Framework 4.5+. Auto-updater compares network build vs local build on launch. UI redistributables shipped alongside; no admin install per user.

deployment.name: Network
deployment.detail: Client → SQL over TCP 1433 (LAN or VPN). SMTP relay for pay-slip email; server-side scheduler for background jobs. Biometric ingest via shared folder or scheduled DB pull.

deployment.name: Web dashboards
deployment.detail: ASP.NET MVC on IIS. Same SQL back-end — no data duplication. Chart.js dashboards vendored offline; no external CDN calls.

wages.title: Wages (Piece-rate / IE)
wages.summary: The wages workforce is driven by coupon-based piece-rate output. The suite handles the full path — days calculation, coupon issue and scan, extra work, corrections, and payment lists (audit & compliance variants).
features: Coupon Suite (Printing, Re-Creation, Adjustment, Duplicate Removal, Tracking, Scan Register, Quality Approval)

compliance.title: Compliance & Statutory
compliance.summary: Pakistan factory-audit and statutory requirements built in.

approvals.title: Who Approves What
approvals.summary: One generic approval engine, configured once and reused across every module. The same Check → Verify → Approve chain drives most flows; extended chains cover the two-step and post-required cases.

alerts.title: Automatic Email Alerts
alerts.summary: The system emails the right person the moment something important happens — an approval sitting in a queue, an OT budget close to its limit, a CNIC about to expire, or a payroll cycle just posted.
